The maintained current-only source planner retains original signed metadata and all five solver outputs, joins complete update/simulation output to the c068717-package subject, and derives an exact280-deb/993-package proposal for32 selected roots. Genuine source run40229579755 at7940c5a0 completed that no-install prefix; earlier failed jobs retain their original outcomes. The old successful artifact lacks the new fifteen-body metadata handoff and cannot be relabelled a complete factory attachment. Changed-source CI owes its new determining output. No solver/source receipt establishes installation or native acceptance.

The fixed preparation route verifies a bounded runtime binary pool and complete patched-source closures for33 selected role packages. Retained bytes are rehashed with no corrupt-input network fallback; signed metadata and source tuples remain determining. The factory expects a separate ATv2 guest with actual root binding, immutable controller/import closure and root-captured pool. Its CLI refuses an unsealed entry before sibling imports; arbitrary user pool paths cannot become privileged inputs. Root-owned seals, complete membership, binding, content and ancestor checks precede installation. These expectations do not establish that the companion baked layer/private caller or actual provider attachment has been delivered or qualified.

The fixed install phase rechecks actual717 base inventory, private early APT_CONFIG/effective controls and the exact frozen proposal before offline installation, audit and993-package readback. Actual role file hashes/owners derive from authenticated Debian archive bodies. Global compiled schemas bind the actual compiler and complete input-tree hash without invented dpkg ownership; a v2 manifest also binds full schema/XKB input trees. A separate phase owns a fresh display, observes US/German keymaps and retires its original actors/display resources before emitting installed-input evidence. Neither source controls nor that proposed prefix supplies browser, Orca, real IME, provider, Studio or whole4817 acceptance.

Each phase retains its process-entry and original overall clocks, absolute nested budgets, post-persistence deadline checks and a15-second cleanup reserve. Reporting failure cannot replace the primary cause or skip bounded cleanup. Sampled aggregate memory includes the authenticated original supervisor and children; missing/drifted readback refuses. Binary/keymap stdout remains separate from retained stderr diagnostics. Ordinary decoded archives stay128MiB; only the exact signed ibus-data digest has a136MiB decoded-tar allowance, propagated through actual decoder output bounds. Acquisition64KiB manifest/128MiB archive/512MiB aggregate bounds remain unchanged. The sampled census retains detached-descendant limits; enforcing outer containment, aggregate allocated storage, capacity and whole-VM retirement remain external obligations. CURRENT_PUBLIC_AT_ADMISSION stays None. Full current-public identity remains the published0.20.0 archive/plan and original Rendering producer, separate from this controller source and any future0.20.1 rebinding.
